# Avsnitt 608 - Bästa traden från utsidan

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-11-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts walk through a chaotic week: Anthropic's IPO, which they subscribed to and flipped for about 30% before it broke below its offer price; a sharp sell-off in AI and semiconductor stocks on the Friday options expiry, with VIX at 36 and a put/call ratio above 1; and a rebound on Monday after Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia, which they see as a dead-cat bounce because Sandisk and Nebius gave back their gains. They also cover tariff headlines, worry that a hawkish Fed could repeat the December 2018 mistake, discuss commodities, gold, silver and copper, and the upcoming SKF spin-off of Vertevo. The episode ends with an interview with the CEO of Gapwaves about scaling up automotive radar antenna production.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SKF-B — SKF | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host plans to own SKF through the Vertevo spin-off dividend, seeing the remaining SKF as the attractive part.

#### Reasoning

The spin-off sends out the low-multiple automotive supplier unit, leaving a cleaner, higher-quality SKF. The host plans to own it through the distribution (last day to own is 25 Nov) and treats it as a special-situations spin-off trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the remaining SKF trades poorly after the spin-off
- if the spin-off terms change

> *"min plan är väl att äga den här över utdelningen och sen så får man se hur det nya Vertevo handlar"*

---

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Co-host bought on the Friday crash and is still long after Jensen's return, betting that systematic flows come back as volatility falls.

#### Reasoning

Bought on capitulation during the Friday options expiry. The host thinks the volume suggests a bottom and that falling volatility will bring systematic fund flows back. The open SEC accounting probe and the China/spy questions are clear risks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if volatility does not come down
- if the SEC probe finds accounting irregularities
- if new chip export restrictions hit

> *"jag är ju lång S&amp, fortfarande och jag är lång Nvidia"*

---

### 🟠 LUMI — Lumi | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Host has started buying a little again after selling near the top. Thinks commodities are getting interesting and the Fed is near peak hawkishness.

#### Reasoning

Commodities, except oil, have fallen on a strong dollar and hawkish Fed talk. The host thinks Fed hawkishness is peaking, which would help commodities. Forced selling to cover AI margin calls also hit commodity holdings.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Fed stays hawkish and the dollar strengthens further
- if the commodity sell-off continues

> *"Jag har ägt Lumi länge men jag sålde mycket där uppe på toppen och det börjar bli sjukt intressant"*

---

### ⛔ SNDK — Sandisk | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Bounced about 20% on the Jensen news, then fell 9%, below the pre-news level. Hosts call it a dead-cat bounce and doubt semiconductors will regain the June peak.

#### Reasoning

Hosts think semiconductors peaked in June. The next leg of any AI rally would come from the application layer, not chips or neoclouds. The failed bounce is a bad sign, though one host bought some premarket.

> *"lägre idag än vad den gjorde innan jensen-nyheten igår. Och det är ett supersunk tecken"*

---

### 🟠 GAPW-B — Gapwaves | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Positive picture from the CEO (guest, not hosts): series production with Valeo and Hella, and antenna volumes going from 4.5m to 10m next year. Rights issue under way.

#### Reasoning

This view comes from the CEO, not the hosts. Revenue is shifting from project income to product income as automotive radar programmes ramp up, and EU safety rules drive demand. The rights issue dilutes shareholders, and there is execution risk in scaling with contract manufacturers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the volume ramp slips
- if Valeo orders decline
- if more dilution is needed

> *"det väntas öka från 4,5 miljoner till 10 miljoner nästa år"*

---
